rules.big_chance: A big chance is a shot whose modelled xG is at least 0.2, the threshold agon.interpret uses for candidate moments.
rules.distance: Distance covered is not measured: it needs tracking data, which the synthetic generator does not produce.
rules.possession: Possession is each club's share of the passes attempted.
rules.speed: Speed and sprints are an on-ball carry proxy (carry displacement over the gap to the next event), not running speed: the synthetic generator produces no tracking data.
rules.star: The star player has the most goals plus assists; a tie goes to the higher xG, then the higher xT added, then the lower shirt number. There is no star player when nobody scored or assisted.
